description: client: messages the front end sends; server: messages it receives.

AddThreat.description:
The command reports an enemy threat or a zone to avoid; the server gives it an id.

A radar and a zone to avoid take ``radius_m``, an enemy jammer ``eirp_w`` and ``bands``.

radius_m.description: Radar range or radius of the zone to avoid, metres.
radius_m.title: Radius M

AddThreat.title: AddThreat

Antenna.description:
Directional antenna, seen from above: a main beam with a hard edge, sidelobes elsewhere.

The cone is horizontal only: the planner is 2D plus time.

azimuth_deg.description: Axis of the main beam, degrees clockwise from north.
azimuth_deg.title: Azimuth Deg

beamwidth_deg.description: Full width of the main beam.
beamwidth_deg.title: Beamwidth Deg

sidelobe_db.description: Gain outside the main beam, relative to the main beam (e.g. -20).
sidelobe_db.title: Sidelobe Db

Antenna.title: Antenna

AvoidZone.description:
Area the command advises against (reported activity, no located emitter).

Shown with the threats and in each mission's zones, but not forbidden: the planner may cross
it. Making routes avoid it when there is a reasonable alternative is still to do.
AvoidZone.title: AvoidZone

Cut.description:
A window during which a friendly jammer is off.

Only a confirmed cut may be used by the planner for the approved route.
